# Shantanu Soam

Creative Systems Engineer building product interfaces, frontend systems, AI-agent tools, canvas experiments, and hardware prototypes.

## Primary routes
- / — proof-first profile and three flagship case studies
- /systems — documented registry of interactive systems
- /blog — essays, build logs, tutorials, and field notes
- /inspo — annotated interface references
- /worth-your-time — curated talks indexed by time
- /raq — rarely asked questions

## Verifiable highlights
- Niva Bupa: 30% lower peak query latency, 15+ critical vulnerabilities resolved, rollback reduced from 20 minutes to under 5.
- Knowbuild: ~40% fewer redundant API calls and virtualized tables with 10k+ rows.
- dnd-dynamic-tree: public npm package and GitHub repository for nested React drag-and-drop trees.
